articles.title: SoftBank reportedly plans $50 billion tech investment in aspiring 'AI nation' Malaysia
articles.description: SoftBank Group reportedly plans to invest $50 billion in Malaysia's technology sector, including artificial intelligence and data centers.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips under $80,000 as traders de-risk ahead of Fed meeting
articles.description: Ether and XRP led losses among the majors as the AI trade took another hit in Asia, where Goldman Sachs cut its Kospi target by 25%.

articles.title: Brazil's Lula wins historic presidential election; Bolsonaro reportedly refuses to concede
articles.description: It's the first time since Brazil returned to direct elections in 1989 that a candidate has won the final runoff after losing in the first round.

articles.title: Hong Kong names Nasdaq-listed Solana Company a strategic enterprise
articles.description: The Nasdaq-listed firm said it plans to establish Solana validator operations in Hong Kong.

articles.title: Elon Musk issues a warning for 'AI neoclouds' as SpaceX borrows $40 billion for chips
articles.description: SpaceX has raised $40 billion in debt to buy GPUs, while Musk predicts a major shakeout among smaller AI cloud providers.

articles.title: Keystone says website breach exposed hardware wallet buyers’ addresses
articles.description: A security researcher warned that the leaked shipping details could expose crypto holders to targeted scams and physical attacks.

articles.title: SpaceX closes $40 billion debt deal for AI chips, Elon Musk says
articles.description: Elon Musk said in an X post that SpaceX has closed $40 billion in debt financing to purchase GPUs.

articles.title: Behind ‘Mad Money’ was a brilliant writer viewers never saw. We lost him too soon
articles.description: Jim Cramer remembers Cliff Mason, the head writer of "Mad Money," who died last week at age 41.

articles.title: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint says it’s not rushing retail stablecoin
articles.description: The Standard Chartered and Animoca Brands joint venture previously targeted retail access as early as the end of 2026, but its CEO declined to reaffirm that timeline.

articles.title: ‘Ticking time bomb’: The world's pension funds face an ageing crisis
articles.description: The world's pension systems are confronting a demographic crisis as longer lifespans and dwindling birth rates threaten to stretch retirement finances.

articles.title: In pictures: Protests over inequality, rising living costs turn violent across France
articles.description: Protests over inequality and living costs drew an estimated 410,000 people across France, with clashes in several cities for a second straight weekend.

articles.title: AI agents help rescue ETH’s Glamsterdam fork, ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site: Hodler’s Digest
articles.description: Similar to the Hugging Face hack, Ethereum researchers have set up an AI Agent message board to help rescue the Glamsterdam fork. ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site successfully hacked.

articles.description: In his Sunday column for Investing Club subscribers, Jim Cramer explains why the AI trade has cracked and what he's doing about it.

articles.title: Blanche defends Trump-ordered lawsuit over Alaska Senate election certification
articles.description: Democrats have maintained they have no connection to Daniel J. Sullivan.

articles.title: Ukraine disputes Elon Musk’s claim that its military violated Starlink terms during drone operations
articles.description: Ukraine challenged Musk’s claim that its military violated Starlink terms, arguing that commercial Starlink limits prevented medium- and long-range strike use.

articles.title: Audi defends plans for a $4 billion Georgia plant amid VW restructuring, tariffs
articles.description: Audi's CEO defended the company's plans for a $4 billion plant in Georgia, calling it a business decision to grow sales and reduce exposure to U.S. tariffs.

articles.title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Intuit Among 6 More Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
articles.description: Twenty-two companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, after Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell, Arm, Moderna. and Intuit joined the list.

articles.title: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
articles.description: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.

articles.title: Latvia targets tokenization rules in 2027 with commercial property in focus
articles.description: Economics Minister Viktors Valainis says rules could arrive in the first half of next year, but an overdue assessment remains unfinished and no sovereign-bond issuance was identified.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Two-Week Losing Streak Despite Late-Week Slide
articles.description: Spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with about $301 million in net inflows, ending a two-week losing streak, even as two straight days of outflows kept October in the red.
